• Emirates complimentary Chauffeur-drive service • Lounge access • Earn 1.9 Skywards Miles for every mile flown • Checked baggage allowance • In-seat mini bar on the A380 and selected Boeing 777 aircraft • Fine dining • Exclusive champagne, wines and spirits • A380 Onboard Lounge • Bvlgari amenity kit on selected flights • Up to 5,000 channels of entertainment • Free unlimited online chat messaging for Emirates Skywards members • Complimentary Wi-Fi for Emirates Skywards Platinum members • Buy great value Wi-Fi plans • Eligible to upgrade with Skywards Miles • Airport fast-track, priority boarding, priority baggage • Changes permitted free of charge • Fully refundable Please refer to the terms and conditions of the fare and the rules of the destination • Please note that if the flight is operated by another airline then the onboard product or service will vary. Brand.Name: BUSINESS
Brand.Title: Business
BUSINESS
Brand.Text:
Aegean's Business Class offers a unique travel experience, with high level of pampering, comfort and convenience.
Fares include: - lounge access - middle seat empty - Free seat selection in Business Class - priority check in, fast track (in selected airports), boarding - 2 pieces of checked luggage (32kg per piece) - cabin baggage: 1 item up to 13kg and 1 personal item women's/men's handbag or a thin laptop case - 3 course meal, hot & cold beverage service, alcoholic drinks - Unlimited free ticket changes (No rebooking fee. Possible charge for fare fee difference) - mileage accrual - Wi-Fi onboard - free Text & Surf and Stream package (on all aircraft that contain IFE system)
• Please note that if the flight is operated by another airline then the onboard product service may be different to that described above.
